name: app-orange-gradient-bar-survey-insights-slide-for-smart-home
title: Orange Segmented Bars Survey Insights
whatItIs: A warm beige rounded slide titled Key Insights From User Research with six survey questions each above a single pill bar split into orange tints, and a legend of percentages and answers below each.
whatItMeans: One hue in graded tints turns survey results into an easy-to-scan ramp, and repeated structure makes six questions feel calm.
techniques: Single horizontal segmented bar per question
One orange in five graded tints
Legend chips with percentage and label

vocabulary.definition: A bar split into parts proportional to answers.
Tints of one hue from dark to light.
A small coloured square with a value and label.
